value.rationale: The claim isolates a structural failure mode of a widely used acceleration method on the simplest class where the underlying iteration is positive, decoupled, and globally contractive. It gives an exact all-dimensional sign law, proves that the usual scalar mixing parameter cannot cure the mechanism, identifies dimension two as minimal, and supplies a positive-map witness that remains negative for the entire standard damping interval. This directly motivates coefficient constraints or accept/reject safeguards when order or positivity matters, rather than merely documenting a numerical anomaly.
